Programme Cadre Qualification

MCA

Associate Professor

Qualifications as above that is for the post of Assistant Professor, as applicable and PhD or equivalent, in appropriate discipline. Post PhD publications and guiding PhD students is highly desirable.

Minimum of 5 years’ experience in teaching / research /industry of which 2 years post PhD experience is desirable.

In case of Architecture, Professional Practice of 5 years as certified by the Council of Architecture shall also be considered valid.
